Thanks for the details and the header dump. Quick summary of what I see:
- The invite URL is generated by Coupa but we run a lightweight redirect service that shortens invite links (for telemetry). The redirect service is misconfigured in the staging->prod promotion and is substituting an internal SFTP host into the Location header when a certain query param (src=shorten) is present.
- That explains why external recipients hit an SFTP host that rejects them (internal host is not public).

Immediate steps I can take:
1) Disable the shorten redirect rule for invites (temporary) — this will make the invite link point directly to Coupa.
2) Reissue a fresh invite for Elena from Coupa after disabling the rule.
3) Long-term: revert the staging config change that added the sftp host into the rewrite map.

I can disable the rule now but I need approval to touch the redirect service. Ben, can you authorize the temporary disable so we can get Luminex onboarded today?

Karthik Iyer
Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
